subject.title: Add unread_count and read state for chats/messages

question: Should imsg core expose unread_count, inbound is_read/date_read, and unread_only/--unread-only as additive public CLI/RPC API now?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but it changes public JSON/RPC output and filter surface, and the related feature request was previously marked as needing maintainer product decision.

options.title: Approve additive core API after complete proof
options.body: Accept these fields and filter in core once the contributor posts live proof for the message-history read-state path as well as the chat filter.

options.title: Request a narrower API shape
options.body: Ask the contributor to rename, gate, or reduce the output/filter surface if strict consumers need a different compatibility story.

options.title: Defer unread state outside core
options.body: Pause or close this direction if maintainers want downstream callers to continue deriving unread state without new imsg API fields.

recommendation.title: Approve additive core API after complete proof
recommendation.body: Accept these fields and filter in core once the contributor posts live proof for the message-history read-state path as well as the chat filter.

likelyOwner.reason: The available current-main history points to Peter for the central MessageStore/CLI/RPC surface and release ownership context.
